reviewScope: One actual PNG candidate: independent scientific visual inspection and targeted compatibility with the existing whole P profile and its two full original cases. No full new P review, D review, trial or learner assessment.

targetedFindings.location: Panel 5, lower-left animal cell in the circular notebook drawing
targetedFindings.observation: In the old JPG the Zellkern leader ends in beige cytoplasm below/right of the purple nucleus. In the pinned PNG it terminates within the lower-left purple nucleus. Native original and candidate notebook crops were actually viewed.
targetedFindings.scope: The local scientific pointer correction is supported at native size; this does not establish readability at small display widths.

targetedFindings.observation: The old external Zellmembran/Zytoplasma labels and their leaders ending on the notebook heading are absent in the PNG. The correct internal Zytoplasma and Zellkern labels remain.
targetedFindings.scope: No replacement biological claim or extra leader is introduced.

targetedFindings.observation: Sample removal, thin wet mount, angled coverslip, low-magnification focusing and labelled documentation remain in an ordered five-step overview. A slanted coverslip and air-bubble avoidance are scientifically suitable for a wet mount. The 45-degree mark is a schematic placement angle, not a quantitative optical measurement.
targetedFindings.scope: This is an introductory wet-mount example, not the entire goal or a complete protocol for every microorganism, tissue, substance or material.

targetedFindings.observation: The microscope remains a recognisable transmitted-light instrument with objective, stage, focusing control and illumination. The observer and the right-hand notebook drawing are readable as the learner-side three-quarter perspective. No concrete new anatomical, ray-path or apparatus contradiction was found in the inspected native detail.
targetedFindings.scope: The existing cartoon composition does not require stylistic replacement.

targetedFindings.location: Actual full candidate at 360 x 201 pixels
targetedFindings.observation: The title and five-panel sequence are recognisable, but step text, starting-magnification guidance, device labels and cell/scale labels are too small for dependable independent reading. The nucleus leader cannot be reliably checked at this width.
targetedFindings.requiredResolution: Do not claim unconditional 360-pixel legibility or completed V coverage of these important details. A genuinely readable presentation or another suitable candidate must be demonstrated.

targetedFindings.location: Actual full candidate at 680 x 380 pixels
targetedFindings.observation: The five main step headings and overall procedure can be read. In the small notebook drawing, Zellkern/Zytoplasma, the exact pointer endpoint and the 50-micrometre label remain too small for dependable independent verification. Native readability does not cure this display-size defect.
targetedFindings.requiredResolution: The correction-critical cell label/pointer and scale need a demonstrated readable presentation at the required size; no blanket approval from the native crop.

targetedFindings.location: Panel 1 specimen preparation versus both actual P protocols
targetedFindings.observation: The drawn person has no visible eye protection, whereas both supplied practical cases explicitly provide/require goggles. The illustration therefore cannot be presented as a complete example of all safety controls in those protocols.
targetedFindings.scope: This is a concrete limit of using the overview as a full practical template. This targeted review does not invent a new chemical hazard, change the protocols or assess actual execution.

PCompatibility.e1: The image illustrates a thin wet-mount workflow. It does not independently evidence selection or actual making of an onion or starch preparation, and it is not a generic method for all materials.
PCompatibility.e2: Low initial magnification and focusing support teaching. Neither the drawing nor a supplied illustration proves observed safe manipulation; the exact P controls, including supervision, goggles, clearance and fine focusing at the 40x objective, remain required in those cases.
PCompatibility.e3: The notebook example depicts animal cells. It is not a model solution for the actual onion or starch cases and is not the learner's drawing, observation or calibration. Its printed 400x/50-micrometre annotations cannot supply a real scale calibration.
PCompatibility.e4: The cases require artefact checks, limits on unseen nuclei, non-cellular starch interpretation and recalibration after a magnification change. The decorative animal-cell example cannot justify adding a nucleus to an unstained onion observation or labelling starch granules as cells.
PCompatibility.independenceBoundary: Both original cases state imageDependency=none. The generic teaching image must not become an answer cue for their independent assessment; the existing conditions withhold solutions/rubrics/transfer expectations until submission.

arithmeticCheck.interpretation: These supplied fictional means and total magnifications are correct. The 100x calibration cannot simply be reused at 400x.

PCompatibility.noActualObservationOrExecution: The two full cases remain future practical-performance designs; no real learner or laboratory record was observed.

formatDecision.decision: Keep the current PNG container and the established wide five-panel composition as the scoped candidate; HOLD unconditional V acceptance because important details fail the stipulated small-width inspection.
formatDecision.reason: Lossless PNG is suitable for the text/leader illustration. Its file type and provider do not resolve geometric text density after downscaling.
